structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words, uses clear Markdown subheadings and ends with a call to action. It has no links or invented quotes, and it leaves out the size, translucency, glitter-dust and small-jar complaints. Its claims match the listing and reviews (12 colors, sturdy cases, shaker cards, resin and epoxy use). The brand-mismatch note is useful.
